turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Who decided to give Owen a zero, and why did he find out on his phone?
I appreciate you coming in with an open mind.
I didn't say open. Who decided?
A lot of parents in your position would have gone straight to the principal. You didn't. That says a lot about you.
Not yet. You've dodged that question twice, Hale.
So I'd like to keep this between us and keep it friendly. Deal?
No deal. Answer me, or we walk down to the principal's office now.
